novelty_search.nearest_positive: Program v12 prospectively maps a resid:10 fixed has/had unembedding contrast through four affine scalars to the rank-one resid:18 carrier write.
novelty_search.nearest_boundary: The v12 upstream read still depends on LM-head weights and does not establish that its reader is the same geometric carrier coordinate as the downstream write.
novelty_search.new_question: Does the weight-free scalar projection q dot resid10 predict the calibrated downstream q write, or must the upstream reader and downstream writer be split?

frozen_design.calibration_rows: The same immutable 16 lexical selection rows and target-guided alpha responses used for v12; eight per direction.
frozen_design.feature: Raw scalar dot(q, resid10_source), with q fixed by the existing resid18 carrier basis; no LM-head weights, token IDs, final margin, donor activation, row outcome IDs, or outcomes enter the feature.
frozen_design.fit: Separate ordinary least-squares intercept+slope per direction, four float64 coefficients total; no ridge, clipping, grid, or confirmation feature.
frozen_design.confirmation_population: All 64 lexicon-v5 rows. Their behavioral result is known from v12 validation, but q dot resid10 has never been read; this is a geometry screen, not a fresh-outcome confirmation.
frozen_design.actuator: alpha = intercept[direction] + slope[direction]*dot(q,resid10_source); patch resid18_source + alpha*q.

opposing_predictions.shared_coordinate: Both direction fits have R^2>=0.50, A1/A2/P each reach mean effect >=0.65 with direction fraction >=0.75, and C<=0.20; treat q as a reusable read/write coordinate pending fresh confirmation.
opposing_predictions.split_reader_writer: Authority and instrument pass but either direction R^2<0.50 or an A/P bar fails; retain v12's unembedding reader and record that the downstream carrier q is not itself the sufficient upstream read coordinate.
opposing_predictions.invalid: Hash, row alignment, basis reconstruction, population capability, final-head replay, finite fit, actuator identity, or coverage fails.

predictions.pred_a_authority_population_capability_a: All authority hashes, 16 calibration IDs, 64 confirmation IDs, population capability cells, rank-one basis, and exact final-head replay pass.
predictions.pred_b_weight_free_fit_and_actuator_well: Each direction has eight nondegenerate finite calibration values, R^2>=0.50, and every alpha is exactly the frozen direction-affine function of q dot resid10.
predictions.pred_c_A_prediction: A1 and A2 each have mean recovery >=0.65 and direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_d_P_generalization: P has mean reflection >=0.65 and direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: Exactly 16 calibration rows and 64 unique confirmation rows yield 64 interventions within 25 forwards, 360 examples, 224 selected-head pairs, zero grids/backwards/updates, and four fit parameters.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: the same weight-free carrier coordinate is a candidate reusable upstream read and downstream write variable.
terminal.null: Authority/instrument/coverage pass but fit or A/P/C causal bars fail: split the upstream reader from downstream writer coordinate.
terminal.invalid: Authority, alignment, capability, final-head, basis, finite-fit, actuator, or coverage failure.
